verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia/Inso CLI explicitly supports CI test automation: `inso run test` returns pass/fail exit codes, `inso lint spec` fails builds on OpenAPI errors, and docs state 'Use the Insomnia CLI to automate the execution of your API tests using your existing Git workflows.' Test collections can be authored/imported from Postman and run in bulk, directly matching the story of running test collections in CI and failing builds on regressions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of CI usage and more detail on regression-detection specifics beyond pass/fail exit codes.
